sourceEvidence.claim: Intro rule 2, whole, verbatim — the amphetamine rule (the page's second paragraph, carried complete)
sourceEvidence.quote:
Amphetamines use the NE transporter (NET) to enter the presynaptic terminal, where they utilize
the vesicular monoamine transporter (VMAT) to enter neurosecretory vesicles. This displaces NE
from the vesicles. Once NE reaches a concentration threshold within the presynaptic terminal,
the action of NET is reversed, and NE is expelled into the synaptic cleft, contributing to the
characteristics and effects of ↑ NE observed in patients taking amphetamines.

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the section's two rules and four-lane flowchart.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the rules and the diagram; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The FIVE SLOTS compression of the two main lanes into one drug-target grid — MAKE (ChAT in the cholinergic lane; the tyrosine→DOPA→dopamine→NE chain in the noradrenergic lane), PACK (VMAT into the vesicle), RELEASE (Ca2+-triggered exocytosis, modulated by the α2 autoreceptor and AT II), LISTEN (Cholinoreceptors M1 M2 M3 vs Adrenoreceptors α β on the POSTSYNAPTIC NEURON), TAKE BACK (NET reuptake vs 'Diffusion, metabolism'; ACh instead is BROKEN by AChE). Every slot, step, drug list, and label is the page's own print; the slot names, the grid view, and the clearance-asymmetry frame (ACh has a BREAKER, NE has a PUMP) are KYP's.
kypExtensions.rationale: The book prints the two lanes as art with scattered labels; the five-slot drug-target grid and the asymmetry frame are KYP's synthesis of the page's own elements.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms + the visual's five-slots digest strip

kypExtensions.summary: The TROJAN HORSE frame for intro rule 2 (amphetamine ENTERS BY the gate [NET], RAIDS the store [VMAT], then OPENS THE GATE BACKWARDS [NET reversal] — NE expelled into the cleft) plus the enzyme-name layer the page does NOT print (VLM-verified: no enzyme labels on the Tyrosine→DOPA or Dopamine→NE arrows; ChAT is the only printed enzyme): tyrosine hydroxylase as the RATE-LIMITING step, dopa decarboxylase, dopamine β-hydroxylase (vesicular), and PNMT — and the adrenal Epi branch (NE → epinephrine in the adrenal medulla), which is the book's OWN print on book 234's overview diagram (the completed PH11 topic), cross-referenced here and flagged as NOT this page.
kypExtensions.rationale: The page prints the rule and the chain without the enzyme names and without any adrenal branch; the Trojan-horse compression, the enzyme layer, and the cross-referenced adrenal limb are KYP's (the limb itself is the book's own, on a different page).
kypExtensions.location: mechanisms + traps + the visual's flagged enzyme chips and adrenal note

kypExtensions.summary: The clinical/drug anchor layer (NONE of these names print on this page): the α2-agonist story (clonidine, guanfacine — ride the printed autoreceptor loop to ↓ sympathetic outflow) and its inverse (α2 blockade, yohimbine — removes the brake); the AT II heteroreceptor reading (angiotensin II facilitates NE release — the printed 'AT II' beside α2); and the monoamine-transporter family frame (NET, DAT, SERT as one system — the page's own three pumps and its four stimulant lists, with methylphenidate at DAT, SSRIs at SERT, cocaine/TCAs/SNRIs/MDMA at NET, and amphetamine on ALL FOUR lists).
kypExtensions.rationale: The page prints the pumps, the lists, the autoreceptor, and AT II, but no agonist/antagonist drug names and no family commentary; the anchor layer and the transporter-family frame are KYP's design.

notes: Census (pdfimages + text layer + VLM render check): the Autonomic drugs section occupies the WHOLE of pdf 260 (book 238) under the standing 'PHARMACOLOGY—AUTONOMIC DRUGS' banner — the only section header on the page. The section prints TWO elements: (1) TWO INTRO RULES (prose) — the α2-autoreceptor negative-feedback rule and the amphetamine NET→VMAT→displacement→threshold→NET-reversal→expulsion rule (both carried VERBATIM in the note's first table block); (2) ONE LARGE FOUR-LANE VECTOR FLOWCHART (CHOLINERGIC / NORADRENERGIC / DOPAMINERGIC / SEROTONERGIC) whose labels print in the text layer — cholinergic chain Choline + Acetyl-CoA →(ChAT)→ ACh with Ca2+-triggered release, Cholinoreceptors M1 M2 M3 on the POSTSYNAPTIC NEURON, AChE → Choline + Acetate, and the anchors 'Botulinum toxin' + 'AChE inhibitors eg, Donepezil'; noradrenergic chain Tyrosine → DOPA → Dopamine → NE with VMAT, 'Vesicular monoamine transporter (VMAT) inhibitor' / 'Tetrabenazine', 'Amphetamine, Ephedrine' at the vesicle, 'Release-modulating receptors' α2 + AT II with the 'Negative feedback' arrow, NET 'Reuptake', 'Amphetamine, SNRIs, Cocaine, TCAs, MDMA' at the pump, Adrenoreceptors α β, and 'Diffusion, metabolism'; the DOPAMINERGIC lane (Tyrosine → L-DOPA → Dopamine, DAT, 'Amphetamine, Methylphenidate, Cocaine', 'Dopamine receptor') and the SEROTONERGIC lane (Tryptophan → 5-Hydroxytryptophan → 5-HT, SERT, 'Amphetamine, SNRIs, Cocaine, SSRIs', '5-HT receptor') under the 'AXONAL TERMINAL' captions. RASTER CENSUS: ZERO raster images on pdf 260 (pdfimages -list returns no rows) — the flowchart is VECTOR LINE ART, COPYRIGHTED, never reproduced; conveyed as ONE original KYP two-lane synthesis map (AutonomicDrugsSynthesisMap). TEXT-LAYER ARTIFACTS pinned: two-layer artwork prints ACh, Tyrosine, Dopamine, 5-HT, Reuptake, and 'Noradrenergic stimulant' multiple times; the vertical 'TERMINAL AXON'/'AXONAL TERMINAL' captions scatter as fragments ('TE' 'L' 'AX' 'ON'; 'AXO' 'NT' 'ER' 'M'/'MI' 'AL'); 'Release-modulating receptors' prints hyphen-less ('Releasemodulating receptors') and 'POSTSYNAPTIC N EURO' splits mid-word — every diagram label quoted in physical order as contiguous line ranges, raw-layer spellings pinned. VLM RENDER CHECK (150-dpi): NO enzyme labels on the Tyrosine→DOPA / Dopamine→NE arrows (no 'tyrosine hydroxylase', no 'dopamine β-hydroxylase' anywhere on the page — ChAT is the ONLY printed enzyme) and NO epinephrine/PNMT/adrenal branch — the noradrenergic lane ENDS at NE; the adrenal Epi limb is the book's own print on book 234 (PH11), cross-referenced and flagged. PAGE-EXTENT FINDING (checked per task): the diagram does NOT extend to pdf 261 — pdf 261 (book 239) opens the SEPARATE pending 'Cholinomimetic agents' section; sourcePages = [260] only. BOUNDARIES: pdf 259 carries the COMPLETED PH16 (EXCLUDED, but its next-page boundary marker named THIS section — the reciprocal anchor is pinned, and this page's M1/M2/M3 + α/β plates resolve into PH16's class letters); pdf 261 opens the PENDING 'Cholinomimetic agents' (EXCLUDED). KYP extensions flagged wherever they appear: the five-slots reading (MAKE, PACK, RELEASE, LISTEN, TAKE BACK), the Trojan-horse frame, the enzyme-name layer (tyrosine hydroxylase rate-limiting, dopa decarboxylase, dopamine β-hydroxylase, PNMT — none printed), the adrenal Epi branch (book 234's own limb), the α2-agonist/antagonist + AT II drug layer, the NET/DAT/SERT family frame, and the clearance-asymmetry frame (ACh has a breaker, NE has a pump).
